en.title: Cinematique Shot Technique Prompts
en.summary: Render one of 150 vendored cinematography techniques (camera, lighting, composition, editing, storytelling, FX, genre styles) into a bound shot prompt for AI image or video generation
en.usage: Select a technique per shot during storyboard breakdown or shot generation, bind the library prompt to the subject, and deliver to image/video models; consumed by domain owners such as Scaena

zh-CN.title: Cinematique 镜头技术提示词库
zh-CN.summary: 把 150 条电影运镜/布光/构图/剪辑/叙事/特效/风格技术中的一条渲染为绑定主体的镜头提示词，直接投递图像或视频生成模型
zh-CN.usage: 分镜拆解或镜头生成阶段逐镜头选择技术、绑定主体后投递；Scaena 等领域 owner 通过 promptrepo 消费。来源 vvsvs.pro/cinematique（免费开放工具），保留署名
